information.description:
Large Two-Legged Ground Drone. As the Minotaur, with a Targeting Scope, and ranged ablation (not acid) 1 less. Its two mounts usually carry a Shingen (40 Improved Smart), an Oni autoshotgun (Excellent ROF2 shotgun, 16 Hyper-Expansive or Improved Smart shells), a flamethrower (4 Incendiary) or a Smart grenade launcher (2 Sonic grenades).

Cost: 30,000eb
MOVE: 4
HP: 40
SP: 16
CN: 14
Counter: DV24 E/S Tech, 5 min to counter
